---------------------------------------------------------
Column Position In Total Image Pixel Matrix | (0048,021E)
---------------------------------------------------------
:Action: Keep (K)
:Justication: [AUTO] Attribute-Module type
:Basic Profile: N/A
:In Modules:
   - vl-whole-slide-microscopy-image-multi-frame-functional-groups [Mandatory (M)] [Required with valid value (1)]::

       <p>
        The column position of the top left hand pixel of the Frame in the Total Pixel Matrix (see
        <span href="">
         Section C.8.12.4.1.1
        </span>
        ). The column position of the top left pixel of the Total Pixel Matrix is 1.
       </p>
       <h3>
        Note
       </h3>
       <p>
        Part of the Plane Position (Slide) Functional Group Macro with usage: C
       </p>
       <p>
        Required if Dimension Organization Type (0020,9311) is not TILED_FULL; may be present otherwise.
       </p>
